name: Campus guessr
summary: A geo-guessing game on a drawn campus map: each round shows a friend's photo redrawn as a little polaroid, you tap the map where you think it was taken and lock your pin, and the reveal draws a line from every friend's pin to the spot with metres off and points. The friend who took the photo always wins that round.
useWhen: geoguessr but it's our campus and our photos
guess where i took this, eastfield edition
make a game out of the photos we sent this semester
a map game for the group chat
dontUseWhen: finding where friends are right now (use come-find-me)
a travel guess on a world map (use guess-where)

campus.description: The campus or town name, e.g. 'Eastfield'

places.description: Up to 10 map landmarks: short name, kind, centre in thousandths of the map; keep x under 330 and y under 450 clear for the photo

rounds.description: Up to 5 photos: who took it, the drawn scene, where it was taken in thousandths of the map, and the caption revealed after guessing

guesses.description: Pins friends already dropped: name, round number from 1, where
